comments.author: jll29
comments.story: Journalist casualties in the Israel-Gaza war
comments.why: Apache footage killing journalists and civilians in Baghdad.
comments.text: War is nasty, it brings out the worst in people. Look at this, listen to their laughter while conducting their "work": [VIDEO] (2007) "The video shows Reuters journalist Namir Noor-Eldeen, driver Saeed Chmagh, and several others as the Apache shoots and kills them in a public square in Eastern Baghdad after they are apparently assumed to be insurgents. After the initial shooting, an unarmed group of adults and children in a minivan arrives on the scene and attempts to transport the wounded. They are fired upon as well. The official statement on this incident initially listed all adults as insurgents and claimed the US military did not know how the deaths ocurred." (We may not have such detailed coverage for Gaza that we have for Baghdad, which is of course also caused by the lack of journalists, since who is dead can no longer report.)
